deals.headline: sc Heerenveen takes a loan secured on future TV-rights income
deals.summary: After the 2024-25 balance-sheet date the club took out a loan from the market, pledging future television-rights income up to the amount drawn, as one of its measures to keep a positive cash position at 30 June 2026. Lender and amount were not disclosed.

name: Sportclub Heerenveen
notes: Latest published accounts are 2024-2025 (year to 30 June 2025, published 11 November 2025); the 2025-26 accounts were not yet published on 2026-10-03. Net result EUR 1,045,993; equity EUR 21.5m, of which EUR 11.06m is the 44.1% stake in Sportstad Heerenveen. The club gives occupancy (89% average in 2024-25, about 15,000 season tickets) rather than an average attendance. The municipality has discussed buying the club's Sportstad shares (FeanOnline, 2022); no transaction found. Chair is from the 2024-25 report (October 2025). No league titles (KNVB Cup winner 2009 per the club's history page). No valuation or social-follower count found on a citable page.

owners.evidence: Als aandeelhouder beheert zij het enige aandeel van S.C. Heerenveen Holding B.V.
owners.name: Stichting Sportclub Heerenveen

ownership_summary: sc Heerenveen is owned by Stichting Sportclub Heerenveen, a foundation whose board includes representatives of supporters' groups, the business club and volunteers. It holds the only share of S.C. Heerenveen Holding B.V., which owns 100% of S.C. Heerenveen B.V. (the KNVB licence holder) and S.C. Heerenveen Vastgoed B.V. No private or institutional investor holds shares; the club itself owns 44.1% of Sportstad Heerenveen B.V., the company that owns its stadium.
